gen-gf-offside-gf-viga: Viga keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase and its strokes clean of hairlines or shadows, a body that stays out of the way. Offside's open, widely tracked letters carry the personality.
gen-gf-offside-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans keeps its capitals low and modern. Offside's open curves and wide tracking take the lead above it, while the sans-serif below stays quietly level.
gen-gf-offside-outfit: Curves that refuse to close give Offside its commanding, widely tracked look, while Outfit below is tidier, with lowercase of moderate height.
gen-gf-offside-plus-jakarta-sans: Expressive is the first word for Offside, with curves left open and wide tracking. Plus Jakarta Sans follows in a monoline plain sans, precise and a bit taller in its lowercase.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-chillax: Chillax feels casual and relaxed, its curves lifted before they close. Oldenburg's shallow lowercase and single-stroke brush look give the sans below something firm to lean against.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-spline-sans: Distinctive describes Oldenburg, with its brush-like single stroke. Spline Sans is a contemporary, approachable plain sans, so long reading feels open, with wide gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable, a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve. And Oldenburg's shallow, brush-drawn lowercase leaves the sans-serif body feeling taller and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-oldenburg-outfit: Distinctive from the first glance, Oldenburg has a single-stroke brush look and shallow lowercase. Outfit sits below it in sans, clean and approachable, so a slightly larger heading would suit that taller body.
gen-gf-oldenburg-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, drawn in a monoline plain sans. Oldenburg is the one for sign-painter swagger and shallow lowercase, while its partner does the quiet, exact work of carrying text.
gen-gf-oldenburg-sora: Commanding is Oldenburg, a brush-like single stroke with shallow lowercase and open curve ends. Sora, a precise geometric sans-serif, does the quieter job of keeping its c and s widely parted.
